groups.title: Storm Clean Up
groups.summary: When storms strike, Gabby’s Tree Service is here to help.
groups.intro: When storms strike, Gabby’s Tree Service is here to help. We provide fast and reliable storm clean-up services across Houston, removing fallen, broken, or hazardous trees from your property. Our expert team safely clears debris, handles emergency tree removal, and includes full cleanup and disposal—leaving your yard safe, clean, and storm-ready again.

groups.title: Tree Removal
groups.summary: Whether it's a dead, diseased, or unwanted tree, Gabby’s Tree Service provides expert tree removal in Houston with safety and efficiency in mind. Our team handles trees of all sizes and includes free debris cleanup and disposal with every removal, leaving your yard clean and ready for new growth.

groups.title: Stump Removal
groups.summary: We specialize in full stump removal for trees of any size.
groups.intro: We specialize in full stump removal for trees of any size. Our team digs out and removes the entire stump—both above and below ground—ensuring nothing is left behind to disrupt your yard. Gabby’s Tree Service also handles all cleanup and disposal, leaving your property clean, level, and ready for new landscaping.

groups.title: Tree Cutting
groups.summary: Tree trimming can be dangerous without the right skills and equipment.
groups.intro: Tree trimming can be dangerous without the right skills and equipment. At Gabby’s Tree Service, our certified professionals use advanced rigging techniques to safely remove overgrown, dead, or diseased branches. We help maintain the health, structure, and appearance of your trees while reducing the risk of damage or injury.

groups.title: Tree Pruning
groups.summary: Tree pruning is a yearly or biannual event that helps a tree produce and grow more effectively.
groups.intro: Tree pruning is a yearly or biannual event that helps a tree produce and grow more effectively. Pruning a tree is different for each tree species - both from when a tree a should be pruned and how it should be pruned.

about.title: About Gabby's Tree Service
text: BBB Accredited Business, licensed and insured, and family-owned — Gabby’s Tree Service has served Deer Park and the surrounding Bay Area for over 22 years. We provide precision tree removal and fast emergency response with our experienced in-house crew — never subcontractors. We arrive on time, offer upfront pricing with no hidden fees, treat your property like it’s our own, and complete every job with full cleanup so your yard is spotless before we leave.

Gabby’s Tree Service is a family-owned tree service in Deer Park, TX, proudly serving local homeowners and businesses since 2002. With more than 22 years of experience, we provide professional tree trimming, tree removal, stump grinding, and emergency tree service with a strong commitment to safety, honest work, and protecting your property.

With over 20 years of hands-on experience, Gabby’s Tree Service proudly serves the Deer Park and surrounding Bay Area with expert tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, and storm preparation. We deliver reliable, high-quality work tailored to your property’s needs.
